title: Certify QF_LRA refutations from the legacy proof object in Lean
summary: Z3's default solver core now records Farkas coefficients on its arithmetic conflicts and bound propagations, so QF_LRA refutations from its proof object can be exported and checked in Lean. Theory lemmas with premises are stated as implications and re-derived before Lean runs; all 28 CI checks passed and the review was approved with one minor finding, fixed.
